description: Returns any product we drove (once the directory opens, with directory.state: audited, in_audit; none: its basic record): its full test-drive result (13 to 35 KB, usually about 19 KB; brief: true gives the headline in 2.5 to 5 KB, usually about 3 KB): how far an agent gets with it and where it stops. slug: its directory slug from search_tools, or its name or domain; an unknown one is an error that names the closest. The full result: the agent level, the five outcomes (find, shown as Learn; access, use, pay, leave, by any way in the product offers; stages: the four that decide the level, under their older keys), how an agent gets in (access, with the core tasks done on each way), the part scores, the nine checkpoints from docs to delete, what an agent can and cannot do, tips for agents, pay_options (the ways to pay it offers an agent, the payment our side proved with its transaction, and what the owner could add), the bot check that stopped our agent on a way in (agent_check: vendor, step, type network or challenge, the owner's fix), after_wall and works_assisted (what it did once a person helped: data only, not counted), robots (a robots.txt rule on the way in; held: the level is from the last drive past it), same_level_drives, confirmation (do the drives agree), the level history with why each move happened (product; agent: our agent or its drive changed; rules; noise), rules_date (the rules the level was set by), audited: its certificate, if any. Since 12 Oct 2026 also routes (every way in and what happened on each), checkout (how far the walk to the last click went), docs (read and judged) and claims (the documented ways to do the core work, tried once each: held, broken, worked but undocumented). newer_drives (drives after the listed one, not listed yet); attempts_count; the attempt log with its evidence is detail.url, for the product's verified owner. Every field: https://agentdrives.com/openapi.json (Tool).
